title: LADA Blue Wings vs Disco Bandoleros, Nov 7
notes: Renton's new camera re-aimed (rink renton2nov, measured on Turbo Kings' Nov 8 game), already pointed this way on Nov 7. Periods come from the board's clock, and each ran to 0.0. The board was dark at the start of the 1st, the end of the 1st and the starts of the 2nd and 3rd, so those four edges come from the clock's run and the frames, within about 2 s. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd.

Played: 10 skaters, with sub goalie Toth #0. Trunov #35 played (his TRUNOV nameplate was read all game), though the game sheet doesn't mark him. Skitsko #16 is marked playing on the sheet, but nothing on the video shows him: OCR's few 16 reads were Disco's #91 and #63. Didn't play: Belousenko #11, Potepalov #15, Skitsko #16, Tverskoy #44, Dukhno #50, Lisenko #55, Horokh #77 and the subs.

Goal times come from the video, each to the second the puck went in. The credits are the game sheet's. Where the frames say otherwise: on the 3-2 goal (2nd period, 6:18) Babkin #26 is the one jabbing at the post and Antonov #95 couldn't be picked out; on Disco's 4-4 goal (3rd period, 8:19) the player at the post wore #45, not the sheet's #36. The board posted Disco's 4-3 goal about 3.5 minutes late.

The score: the game sheet and LADA have 5-5, and so does this page. The video shows one more goal, for us, at 60:48 (about 1:45 left in the 3rd): a scramble at Disco's net, the board added a home goal and a home shot, and play restarted at center ice. The board ended 6-5. The scorer can't be read, and this page keeps the official 5-5.

Lineups were checked by eye: 49 on/off spans fix line changes the tracker missed. Two of them (Charnysh #36 at 576-595 and Gareev #53 at 3497-3544) were added from what the checkers saw at the 1-1 and 5-4 goals, after their first pass. Charnysh's tracks in the 2nd carried no number, so three of his shifts there (24:00-24:43, 27:51-29:21 and 31:48-32:28 of the video) were found by eye. Shipachev's 5:16 shift in the 2nd is real: he never sat, and his linemates' shifts were as long.
From behind, Trunov #35 and Charnysh #36 look alike (dark helmet, black shorts, white socks), and one Disco player wears a navy jersey with white shoulders that passes for ours.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 14:06: jammed in from a scramble at their crease, 1-0
1st period, clock 8:24: a goalmouth scramble with one of theirs on our goalie, 1-1
1st period, clock 1:42: Charnysh cuts across the crease and tucks it in, 2-1
2nd period, clock 10:15: cuts across our crease and scores, 2-2
2nd period, clock 6:18: poked in during a scramble at their right post, 3-2
2nd period, clock 5:24: Charnysh drives in and pushes it in as he falls in the crease, 4-2
3rd period, clock 17:02: jammed in at the near post, 4-3
3rd period, clock 8:19: jammed in at the post in a scramble, 4-4
3rd period, clock 3:07: in alone on a breakaway, Charnysh's hat trick, 5-4
3rd period, clock 0:01: they crash our net and pile on our goalie with a second left, 5-5
